continuation_job_occupancy.definition: full child process lifetime; not kernel-active GPU time

source_job_occupancy.definition: job launch to observed process exit; includes loading, evaluation, checkpoints and waits

native_framing.adaptation: original raw UTF-8 retokenized with pinned Qwen3.8 tokenizer; evidence uses native 128-token local prefix
native_framing.labels: native logits aligned to the following token; initial 128 later tokens unscored

manifest.query_execution: torch.no_grad native reader; unchanged zero sentinel, batch sizes and padding; no backward
manifest.scope: fixed continuation benefit and direction controls

summary.aggregation: mean target NLL within family, then equal-family macro
summary.delta_definition: control NLL minus self NLL; positive means improvement
summary.direction_definition: mean of three permuted-read NLLs minus original NLL within each family; positive means aligned direction helps
summary.retention_definition: delta at distance minus paired delta at zero; zero means no change
